en-US.description: Let any AI agent use your iPhone or Android phone from your computer, with you in the loop.
en-US.longDescription: Pinky lets any agent (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor or a script) operate a real iPhone or Android phone over MCP, while you watch on your computer, approve risky steps, take over and review what happened. Approvals are enforced by Pinky's gateway, not by instructions to the agent.
en-US.name: Pinky
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Ask Pinky now works with OpenAI's GPT-6 models, such as GPT-6.1 Terra, which use tools only through OpenAI's Responses API. Other OpenAI-compatible services switch to it by themselves when a model needs it.
- Checking a model no longer says it answered without using a tool when the service refused the request: it shows what the service said and what to do.
- GPT-6.1 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol join GPT-5.6 Terra in OpenAI's suggested models; GPT-5.6 Terra stays the default.

zh-CN.description: 让任何 AI Agent 在你的电脑上操作 iPhone 或 Android 手机，关键一步由你决定。
zh-CN.longDescription: Pinky 让任何 Agent（Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、Cursor，或者一段脚本）通过 MCP 操作真实的 iPhone 或 Android 手机。你在电脑上看着它干活，有风险的步骤由你批准，随时可以接管，事后还能回看。审批由 Pinky 的网关执行，不靠给 Agent 的指令。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
- 「交给 Pinky」现在可以使用 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 系列模型，比如 GPT-6.1 Terra。这些模型只能通过 OpenAI 的 Responses API 调用工具；其他兼容 OpenAI 的服务遇到需要它的模型时，也会自动改用。
- 检查模型时，如果是服务拒绝了请求，不会再说模型回应了但没调用工具，而是显示服务的原话和该怎么做。
- OpenAI 的推荐模型新增 GPT-6.1 Terra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol，默认仍是 GPT-5.6 Terra。
